guide.title: How the proactive assistant works
guide.intro: It's optional and only acts when you turn it on. When you mention something with excitement (a concert, a trip, a product), it searches the web and brings a short summary with sources.
guide.step1: Turn on the toggle above. You can switch it off anytime — nothing is lost.
guide.step2: The summary appears in the conversation only after the model finishes answering; it never interrupts.
guide.step3: If you were away, it waits for you to come back and shows “while you were away…”.
guide.step4: Tap “Know more” to continue in the same chat or open a new one; “Dismiss” quietly hides it.
guide.step5: “Not this” blocks the topic; you can unblock it here anytime.
guide.privacy: Privacy: it never researches private people, only you see your insights and everything is deleted after 30 days. Admins only see counters and short labels, never your messages.
